Name: Flipping Flamingos (AT) by Wickedy
Author: WickedyWoah
Description:
How is this not already a thing? 

Our poor flamingos have been forced to me alone forever, unable to make eye contact or have real connections with each other. Well, [size=3][b]Flipping Flamingos is here to help![/b][/size]

With the help of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ mod, you can now flip that flamingo right around and no longer have to worry about your lawn flamingos not being able to find their soul mate.

I also love the idea of little baby flamingos, so I added a light pink baby flamingo, as in nature they are born with white feathers and gain their pink color from the food that they eat as they grow. I settled on a paler pink.

[b]Added bonus:[/b] this mod has no compatibility issues with BlaDe's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12015]Flamingo Breeding[/url] mod, in fact, making this was inspired by my frustration of not being able to make the flamingos kiss and by watching him showcase his mod. The new flamingos that pop out will be the default lawn flamingo though, but you can recolor them to be the babies I've included after breeding.

Downloads.Description: Flip those flamingos around for better farm decoration symmetry, plus babies!
